parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json.body;const required=['vendors','evaluation_criteria'];const missing=required.filter(f=>!body[f]);if(missing.length)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'Missing: '+missing.join(', ')}}];const vendors=Array.isArray(body.vendors)?body.vendors:[];if(vendors.length<2)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'vendors must have at least 2 entries'}}];const criteria=Array.isArray(body.evaluation_criteria)?body.evaluation_criteria:(body.evaluation_criteria||'').split('\n').map(c=>c.trim()).filter(Boolean);if(criteria.length===0)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'evaluation_criteria must be non-empty'}}];const formattedVendors=vendors.slice(0,8).map((v,i)=>({name:(v.name||'Vendor '+(i+1)).trim(),pricingInfo:(v.pricing_info||'').slice(0,300),knownFeatures:(v.known_features||'').slice(0,600),notes:(v.notes||'').slice(0,400)}));return[{json:{valid:true,decisionContext:(body.decision_context||'').slice(0,400),vendors:formattedVendors,vendorCount:formattedVendors.length,evaluationCriteria:criteria.slice(0,15),weightings:body.weightings||{},dealBreakers:Array.isArray(body.deal_breakers)?body.deal_breakers:(body.deal_breakers||'').split('\n').map(d=>d.trim()).filter(Boolean),budgetConstraint:(body.budget_constraint||'').slice(0,200),replyEmail:body.reply_email||null}}];

const results=$('Research Vendors').first().json?.results||[];const input=$('Validate Input').first().json;const context=results.map(r=>r.title+': '+(r.content||r.snippet||'').slice(0,300)).join('\n');return[{json:{input,researchContext:context||'No comparison data found publicly.'}}];

values.content: You build vendor comparison matrices for buying decisions. Good comparisons: score each vendor honestly on each criterion (not artificially balanced), flag deal-breakers clearly, are transparent about uncertainty when public information is limited, and end with a clear recommendation with rationale rather than leaving the reader to guess. You do not favor any vendor by default — you follow the evidence. Always respond in valid JSON only.
